observations.title: US breeding and nursery base
observations.summary: Fall Creek identifies Oregon as its origin and the United States as a nursery and R&D location for blueberry genetics.

observations.title: Naturipe and Hortifrut announce MBO collaboration
observations.summary: The companies announced access to additional elite MBO blueberry selections for the US, Mexico, Peru and other Latin American countries. Exclusivity and cultivar-specific terms were not disclosed.

observations.title: Hortifrut’s Peruvian blueberry operations
observations.summary: Hortifrut describes 1,800 ha associated with its 2018 Grupo Rocío combination in Trujillo and the Chao Valley plus 400 ha with Atlantic Blue in Olmos.

metric.scope: Hortifrut Peru including disclosed Atlantic Blue joint operation
metric.qualifier: Company snapshot without a measurement date

observations.title: Hortifrut’s Peruvian packing footprint
observations.summary: Hortifrut says the Grupo Rocío combination included blueberry packing facilities and equipment in northern Peru. Current capacity was not disclosed.

observations.title: Planasa’s blueberry nursery program in Mexico
observations.summary: Planasa’s Spanish-language disclosure identifies blueberry propagation at its Dolores Hidalgo nursery operations.

observations.title: Fall Creek’s Iberian blueberry nursery
observations.summary: Fall Creek describes its Spanish nursery operation and its work with European blueberry growers. The operation’s presence does not establish rights by country.

observations.title: African Blue’s Southern African Costa licenses
observations.summary: Costa reports that African Blue licensed Costa blueberry varieties to growers in South Africa, Zimbabwe and Zambia for counter-seasonal supply to African Blue in Morocco. Full contracts and exclusivity were not disclosed.

observations.title: South African production under sublicenses
observations.summary: Costa reports 189 ha of Costa varieties grown through Total Produce Holdings sublicensees. The brochure does not date this measurement or identify a named cultivar per grower.

metric.scope: Costa varieties grown through the South African Total Produce Holdings sublicense group
metric.qualifier: Company brochure snapshot without a measurement date

observations.title: Fall Creek South Africa nursery and R&D
observations.summary: Fall Creek identifies South Africa among the locations of its blueberry nursery and R&D operations.

observations.title: Hortifrut’s JoyWingMau collaboration
observations.summary: Hortifrut describes a China collaboration with JoyWingMau that includes blueberry production, logistics and supermarket commercialization.

metric.scope: Blueberry production in northern China described in the JoyWingMau collaboration
metric.qualifier: More than; company snapshot without a measurement date

observations.title: Naturipe and Joyvio supermarket route
observations.summary: Hortifrut reports direct commercialization to domestic and international supermarket chains in China under the Naturipe and Joyvio brands. Chains and terms are not named.

observations.title: Sapphire licensee disclosure for Japan
observations.summary: Florida Foundation Seed Producers lists Ozeki Blueberry Nursery as a licensee in Japan for Sapphire. The disclosure is a licensing source and legal registry status requires a separate check.

observations.entity_name: UC Davis Public Strawberry Breeding Program
observations.title: UC Davis licensed strawberry nursery channel
observations.summary: UC Davis lists licensed nurseries and describes how to request a license for propagation or transfer. Its catalog includes UC Golden Gate, UC Keystone and UC Monarch.

observations.entity_name: UC Davis Public Strawberry Breeding Program
observations.title: UC Davis public strawberry breeding program
observations.summary: UC Davis identified an active public breeding and licensing program and reported 20 strawberry varieties with active patents in its May 2024 disclosure.

metric.scope: UC Davis strawberry varieties as described by the university

observations.title: Planasa’s strawberry nursery program in Mexico
observations.summary: Planasa identifies strawberry propagation at its three Dolores Hidalgo sites. Its annual production figure covers all four berry crops combined.

metric.scope: Planasa Dolores Hidalgo nursery, all four berry crops combined
metric.qualifier: More than; disclosed output without a measurement year

observations.title: BerryGood strawberry production in Minas Gerais
observations.summary: Hortifrut reports that its Brazilian business includes its own strawberry production in Minas Gerais, commercialized through BerryGood.

observations.title: AVA strawberry breeding
observations.summary: Angus Soft Fruits lists strawberry among the crops developed by its AVA Berries breeding programme in the UK.

observations.title: BerryWorld’s counter-seasonal strawberry supply
observations.summary: BerryWorld describes serving UK demand with UK strawberries in season and supplying from markets including Spain and Morocco in other periods.

observations.title: Planasa’s Kénitra strawberry nursery
observations.summary: Planasa identifies a strawberry plant nursery at its Kénitra operation. The disclosure does not state cultivar-level rights or nursery capacity.

observations.title: Piñata Farms grows for BerryWorld
observations.summary: BerryWorld identifies Piñata Farms as an Australian strawberry grower and reports commercial BerryWorld-branded strawberry harvest beginning in 2017.

metric.qualifier: Approximately; grower profile does not date the measurement

observations.entity_name: NARO and Mie, Kagawa and Chiba prefectures
observations.title: YOTSUBOSHI registration in Japan
observations.summary: MAFF records denomination YOTSUBOSHI, application 28844 filed January 10, 2014 and registration 25605 dated February 8, 2017. NARO and the prefectures of Mie, Kagawa and Chiba are listed as registrants.
observations.source_name: Japan Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries

observations.title: Cornell releases and licenses two primocane raspberries
observations.summary: Cornell reports that licensed nurseries offered Crimson Beauty and Crimson Blush for spring 2025 planting after release. The same report distinguishes a separate set of strawberry and raspberry selections propagated for farm trials.
observations.source_name: Cornell College of Agriculture and Life Sciences

observations.title: Planasa’s raspberry nursery program in Mexico
observations.summary: Planasa identifies raspberry propagation at Dolores Hidalgo. The nursery’s disclosed capacity combines multiple crops.

observations.title: Hortifrut Mexico’s raspberry export channel
observations.summary: Hortifrut describes its Mexican export company supplying raspberries to the group’s commercial platforms.

observations.title: Niab’s Malling Bella raspberry
observations.summary: Niab records Malling Bella as a mid-season primocane released in 2017, suited to double-cropping and long canes. The source provides a licensing contact and says disease resistance testing had not been undertaken.

observations.title: Kelsey Farms’ Vicentina show milestone
observations.summary: Hortifrut reported that Kelsey Farms grew and exhibited Vicentina and that it received two awards at the 2026 UK show. This supports a named growing relationship and award, with commercial acreage still unknown.

observations.title: Qualiprim grows raspberries for BerryWorld
observations.summary: BerryWorld identifies Qualiprim as a Moroccan raspberry and blueberry supplier near Agadir. The disclosed 26 farms cover the grower’s produce operations, with no raspberry-only split.

metric.scope: Qualiprim overall produce operations in Souss
metric.qualifier: Company profile does not date the footprint

observations.title: Piñata Farms and BerryWorld specialty raspberries
observations.summary: BerryWorld identifies its Australian Piñata Farms partnership as adding specialty raspberries in 2018.

observations.title: Australian Rubus nursery channels
observations.summary: Berries Australia says many newer Rubus varieties are protected and much commercial material is supplied through variety owners. It cites Driscoll’s as an example and lists other commercial nurseries.

observations.title: Sweet-Ark Immaculate floricane release
observations.summary: Arkansas announced release of the late-season, thornless, floricane-fruiting blackberry on February 8, 2024. The university reported that licensed commercial propagators had material for the 2024 planting season.

observations.title: Arkansas primocane blackberry program
observations.summary: The university documents historical releases including Prime-Ark 45 and the thornless primocane-fruiting Prime-Ark Freedom. This is a separate breeding track from the 2024 Immaculate floricane release.

observations.title: APHIS regulatory status determination for a Pairwise blackberry
observations.summary: APHIS determined that the specific blackberry described in RSR 24-087-01rsr was outside 7 CFR part 340 because it was unlikely to pose increased plant pest risk. The source establishes a regulatory milestone for that submission, with commercial deployment unconfirmed.

observations.title: Planasa’s blackberry nursery program in Mexico
observations.summary: Planasa names blackberry among the crops it propagates at Dolores Hidalgo. Cultivar-level supply and terms need confirmation.

observations.title: Hortifrut Mexico’s blackberry export channel
observations.summary: Hortifrut identifies blackberries among the crops supplied via its Mexican export business to international commercial platforms.

observations.title: AVA blackberry breeding
observations.summary: Angus Soft Fruits identifies blackberry as a crop in its AVA breeding programme. No propagation territory is inferred from the programme listing.

observations.title: Frutadivina grows blackberries for BerryWorld
observations.summary: BerryWorld identifies Portugal’s Frutadivina as a raspberry and blackberry supplier. Variety identities and volume are unknown.

observations.title: Afrifruit’s Moroccan blackberry operations
observations.summary: Afrifruit names blackberry in its portfolio in Agadir and Moulay Bousselham. Its investor separately identifies Europe as a destination for the red-fruit business.

observations.title: Domangad blackberry packing and export
observations.summary: Import Promotion Desk identifies Domangad as a Moroccan grower, packer and exporter for blackberries and other berries. Independent packing capacity and customer assignments are unknown.

observations.title: Driscoll’s regional blackberry production program
observations.summary: Driscoll’s Australia and New Zealand describes its grower program and blackberry field cycle. The disclosure gives no blackberry farm list or country-specific volume.

observations.title: Australian Rubus propagation channel
observations.summary: Berries Australia reports that most commercial Rubus varieties are supplied through the variety owner. The source gives a channel-level signal and does not name authorized blackberry cultivars or territorial terms.

observations.title: Cornell releases and licenses two primocane raspberries
observations.summary: Cornell reports that licensed nurseries offered Crimson Beauty and Crimson Blush for spring 2025 planting after release. The same report distinguishes a separate set of strawberry and raspberry selections propagated for farm trials.
observations.source_name: Cornell College of Agriculture and Life Sciences

observations.title: Afrifruit’s European blackberry market
observations.summary: Afrifruit’s investor identifies European markets for the Moroccan producer’s raspberries, blueberries and blackberries. Named distributors and retailer programs are undisclosed.

observations.title: Afrifruit’s Moroccan strawberry operations
observations.summary: Afrifruit identifies strawberry among the four crops it produces in its north and south Moroccan operating regions.

observations.title: MBO blueberry selections for Mexico and Peru
observations.summary: The companies announced access to additional elite MBO blueberry selections for the US, Mexico, Peru and other Latin American countries. Exclusivity and cultivar-specific terms were not disclosed.

observations.title: Domangad’s Moroccan blackberry export role
observations.summary: Import Promotion Desk identifies Domangad as a Moroccan grower, packer and exporter for blackberries and other berries. Independent packing capacity and customer assignments are unknown.

observations.entity_name: UC Davis Public Strawberry Breeding Program
observations.title: UC Davis reports U.S. nursery licensing
observations.summary: UC Davis says it directly licenses to nurseries in California, elsewhere in the United States and in Canada. The grant and status of a specific right need individual registry verification.

observations.title: M&S announces a Northern Ireland strawberry program
observations.summary: M&S announced that Co. Armagh grower O’Malley Berry Co. would supply its 22 Northern Ireland stores from April through November and identified Dole Ireland as helping bring the berries to shelves. Delivered volume and exclusivity were undisclosed.

metric.scope: M&S stores in Northern Ireland covered by the announced strawberry program

searched_gaps.reason: The Afrifruit and Domangad profiles identify crop operations, but no blackberry cultivar holder or local license scope.
searched_gaps.next_step: Find named cultivars through exporters and breeder catalogues, then verify the Moroccan rights with the national register.

searched_gaps.reason: Berries Australia identifies the licensed Rubus channel without denomination-level blackberry rights.
searched_gaps.next_step: Search Australian PBR by Rubus and cross-check any marketed cultivar against applicant, grant and current status.

searched_gaps.reason: Planasa México confirms propagation and Hortifrut confirms exports, but neither source discloses cultivar-level rights.
searched_gaps.next_step: Search Mexico’s SNICS register for zarzamora denominations and compare holders with licensed nursery offerings.

searched_gaps.reason: BerryWorld’s Qualiprim profile identifies production and certification without a named crop-specific packhouse.
searched_gaps.next_step: Cross-check named Moroccan raspberry packers and match each packing facility to a current exporter or grower.

searched_gaps.reason: Planasa confirms a Kénitra strawberry nursery without naming the cultivar rights held or exercisable there.
searched_gaps.next_step: Resolve trademark versus legal denomination for marketed selections and check the Moroccan register before evaluating a license.

searched_gaps.reason: Hortifrut describes logistics in China but does not identify an independent distributor, capacity or exclusivity.
searched_gaps.next_step: Resolve the legal JV entity and verify its current activities through original local-language company disclosures.

event_candidates.title: UC Davis announces termination of Eurosemillas strawberry licensing agreements
event_candidates.summary: UC Davis announced termination of Eurosemillas’s older-cultivar international strawberry agreements on May 21, 2024. UC Davis said its newer-cultivar agreements with Fresa Fortaleza and Global Plant Genetics continued. The announcement does not establish the current availability or legal status of each variety in each country.

event_candidates.title: AgroBerries and BerryWorld Group announce combination
event_candidates.summary: BerryWorld’s announcement identifies the acquisition of BerryWorld Group by AgroBerries. AgroBerries later confirmed it acquired the group in 2024. BerryWorld’s notice distinguishes its group from the North American brand operated by Mastronardi Produce. The exact legal closing date is unconfirmed in these sources.
